title: London Stadium

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation sampled just outside the mapped southeast main entrance.

mapIdentity.scope: The OSM stadium multipolygon contains 59 outer and 69 inner roof controls. The mapped turf controls pitch centre and bearing, and the mapped southeast entrance fixes the datum.

note: The independent original DEM places the field about 5.1 m below the southeast approach. The synthetic field surface sits 0.17 m above the sample mean to avoid cutting the preserved elevation. Rail, fascia, roof heights and sections are inferred from the mapped shape, released images and engineering text.
